prompts: Edit this original fantasy tactical RPG sprite atlas into an original enemy army variant. Preserve the EXACT atlas structure: 8 equal-height rows and 12 equal-width columns, one character pose per cell, same positions, sizes, foot baselines, weapons, facing directions, poses and silhouettes as the supplied image. Keep each sprite entirely inside its own cell with clear transparent gutters. Preserve the crisp outlined hand-painted small game sprite style. Change clothing, cloaks, banners, and scarves to coordinated muted crimson, burgundy and charcoal, with restrained bronze trim and silver-gray steel. Keep skin, hair, wooden weapons and the brown horses natural colors; no red tint over the entire character. Change headgear by row, consistently across every facing and pose: row 1 sword vanguard has a low steel brow guard and crimson hood framing the face; row 2 armored spear knight retains a closed steel helmet with a crimson plume; row 3 archer wears a dark crimson ranger hood; row 4 spellcaster wears a charcoal hood with crimson lining; row 5 staff healer wears a restrained burgundy veil/cowl; row 6 mounted lancer wears a steel helmet with a short crimson plume and the HORSE remains brown; row 7 axe corsair has a burgundy bandana; row 8 light swordsman has a charcoal lower-face scarf and crimson trailing scarf. Keep all original held weapons and attack effects. No new shields on classes that did not have one. No new characters, no missing cells, no changed row or column counts. Entire sheet has real alpha transparency including all spaces between characters and limbs: no background paint, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no labels, no logos, no scenery. All designs original. This is an asset edit, not a game screenshot.

Edit this original enemy army sprite atlas only to increase transparent gutters. Preserve exactly 8 rows and 12 columns and the identical characters, poses, facing directions, clothing, natural skin and brown horses, weapons, effects, crimson/charcoal/steel palette, and crisp painted style. In EVERY cell, scale the entire existing sprite uniformly to 80 percent of its current size, center it horizontally in its cell, and put its lowest foot at 90 percent down the cell. Each equal cell is 1/12 of the sheet width by 1/8 of its height. No part of any character, horse, weapon or effect may cross into an adjacent cell. Leave completely transparent space on all four sides of every sprite, especially around the cavalry horses and lance tips. No missing poses, no new poses, no extra characters, no removed weapons, no cropping. Keep exact 1536 by 1024 atlas aspect and grid layout. Preserve real alpha transparency, including gaps among limbs. No painted background, no checkerboard, no grid, no labels or text.

Precise object edit of this original transparent 8-row by 12-column sprite atlas. Change ONLY ONE sprite: the mounted cavalry attack in row 6, column 11 (rows and columns numbered from 1 at the upper left). Its lance currently extends too far to the right into column 12. Shorten the lance so its rightmost tip stops well inside its own cell, at about pixel x=1388 in this 1536-pixel-wide sheet. Preserve the attacking rider and brown horse completely. Leave a wide genuinely transparent vertical gap from x=1400 to x=1417 in row 6, with no lance or stray pixels. Do not change ANY other sprite, any other weapon, any other row, any other column, any positions, scales, colors, lighting, style, faces or poses. Keep the original 1536 by 1024 dimensions, exact 8 by 12 grid, all 96 characters, and real alpha transparency including all background and gutters. No text, no grid lines, no checkerboard, no background.
